rules: Online reference photographs may be displayed only when their source, creator, date where known, reuse licence and attribution are recorded.
Clearly distinguish street-context/reference images from photographs verified as depicting the exact catalogue object.
Founder-captured original photographs must remain separately identified and credited to the founder.
Create founder line art only from the corresponding founder-captured original photograph unless a separate rights-cleared source and adaptation permission are documented.
Preserve original photographs separately from derivative artwork.
Photographs do not independently verify exact object coordinates.
Do not change archive record IDs or mark founder photography complete before founder confirmation.
